name: thousand-refractions-prepare-1-paid-non-assassin-no-wake-no-return
notes: Thousand Refractions (XLbCBxla8K, LUXEM ASSASSIN ATTACK, reserve 0, printed power 1): "Prepare 1. [Class Bonus] On Hit: If Thousand Refractions was prepared, wake up your champion and return Thousand Refractions to its owner's hand." Player 2 keeps the deck's default Spirit of Fire champion (class SPIRIT; lineage patched with a LUXEM champion so the card is playable) with 1 preparation counter: Prepare 1 is payable but the On Hit is a [Class Bonus] and does NOT apply: the champion stays rested and the card goes to the graveyard.

rulesClauses: [Class Bonus] On Hit: If Thousand Refractions was prepared, wake up your champion and return Thousand Refractions to its owner's hand.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Second defect behind this card's Prepare wiring: its generated onHitAbilities['XLbCBxla8K:0'] (wake up + return to hand) gated '[Class Bonus]' with IsClassBonusActive($player) called with NO required-classes list, which only checks 'controls any champion' (always true), so a prepared copy played by a non-Assassin champion would still have gotten the rider. Fix: GAWrapClassBonusGate() in Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php re-gates it on ASSASSIN (live: the unwrapped rider fired for a Spirit of Fire champion).
